description: Crop an image to a pixel box or a 0 to 1 ratio box. circle cuts a round mask. format is png, jpeg, or webp. Send base64 or a public URL. Private addresses are refused and the decoded file is capped at 10 MB. Returns the image as base64.

file.description: The image. Provide url or data.

data.description: Base64 bytes or a data URI. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB.

filename.description: File name, including the extension when you have one.

mimeType.description: MIME type when you know it.

url.description: Public http or https URL. Private and local addresses are refused.

unit.description: px is source pixels. ratio is a 0 to 1 share of the source.

name: crop_image
title: Crop an image
